_transcription: ENGLISH PAGES = EVEN indices 2,4,6,8,10,12,14,16,18 (idx 0 = cover, idx 1 = Hindi General Instructions). Every ODD index 1-17 was checked at full size or on contact.png and is PURE HINDI with NO English overflow at its top; idx 17 (the highest-risk page, second from last) was confirmed at full size. idx 18 is the ENGLISH-ONLY final page. The alternating hypothesis held for the whole booklet with no parity inversion. Q1-35 run unbroken across the nine English pages with every sub-part and every OR branch present: Q1-3 (idx 2), Q4-9 (idx 4), Q10-15 (idx 6), Q16-22 (idx 8), Q23-26 (idx 10), Q27-30 (idx 12), Q31 + Q32 passage (idx 14), Q32 sub-parts + Q33-34(a) (idx 16), Q34(b) + Q35 (idx 18). Decimal points on this paper are RAISED (0·80 V, 31·84 mm Hg, 5·55 × 10^3), so they are written {\cdot}; its marking scheme prints raised dots too. Section-A answers are taken VERBATIM from the marking scheme's Section-A table (ms/p02.png), uppercased; all 18 entries present. The WHOLE marking scheme (ms/p02-p07) was walked for award-regardless wording: the only three void notes are Q2, Q4 and Q14, all in Section A, all letter-plus-note. plan.txt for this paper reads 'no marking scheme found for 2023 56-1-2' and is WRONG - ms/ holds all 8 pages and its header names 56/1/2 explicitly.

questions.stem:
\(\mathrm{Ag^{+}\,(aq)} + \mathrm{e^{-}} \longrightarrow \mathrm{Ag\,(s)}\qquad \mathrm{E}^{\circ} = +\,0{\cdot}80\) V
\(\mathrm{Fe^{2+}\,(aq)} + 2\mathrm{e^{-}} \longrightarrow \mathrm{Fe\,(s)}\qquad \mathrm{E}^{\circ} = -\,0{\cdot}44\) V
Find the \(\mathrm{E}^{\circ}_{\mathrm{cell}}\) for :
\(\mathrm{Fe\,(s)} + 2\mathrm{Ag^{+}\,(aq)} \longrightarrow \mathrm{Fe^{2+}\,(aq)} + 2\mathrm{Ag\,(s)}\)
A first order reaction takes 30 minutes for 50% completion. The value of rate constant k would be :
questions._cbseVoided: (d) / Full mark to be awarded for any option.
questions._flag: NO printed option is correct, which is evidently why CBSE voided it. k = 0.693/30 min = 2.31 x 10^-2 min^-1; option (d) carries the right mantissa with the exponent an order of magnitude too small, and the other three match nothing. All four exponents were re-read on idx 4 at full size. The printed letter (d) is kept as `answer` per the addendum's letter-plus-note rule - this is NOT a keyless void, since CBSE did print a letter.

questions.stem:
(i) Carry out the following conversions :
(1) Ethanal to But-2-en-1-al
(2) Propanoic acid to 2-chloropropanoic acid
(ii) An alkene with molecular formula \(\mathrm{C_5H_{10}}\) on ozonolysis gives a mixture of two compounds 'B' and 'C'. Compound 'B' gives positive Fehling test and also reacts with iodine and NaOH solution. Compound 'C' does not give Fehling solution test but forms iodoform. Identify the compounds 'A', 'B' and 'C'.
questions._flag: Two things. (1) TAXONOMY: conversion (i)(2) propanoic acid -> 2-chloropropanoic acid is the Hell-Volhard-Zelinsky reaction and belongs to 'Chemical Reactions of Carboxylic Acids'; the row is filed on 'Chemical Reactions of Aldehydes and Ketones', which covers (i)(1) and the whole 3-mark part (ii). (2) DEFECT AS PRINTED: sub-part (ii) asks to identify 'A', 'B' and 'C' but never labels the alkene 'A' - it is introduced only as 'An alkene with molecular formula C5H10'. Transcribed as printed. The marking scheme resolves it the obvious way (A = 2-Methylbut-2-ene, B = Ethanal, C = Propanone), confirming the alkene IS the intended 'A'.
